content:
Olivia: Heads up — PR #7421 blocked by security scan in CI. The web-login smoke test that DAST uses is failing after Thursday's permission cleanup. Logs below.

scan-bot: DAST RUN 2025-06-12T15:04:21Z - test: web-login-smoke - status: FAIL - step: auth-callback

Olivia: here's the failing snippet:
```
POST /auth/callback 401
Auth service error: token exchange failed: 403 Forbidden - serviceAccountTokenCreator not granted to scanner-sa@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

Jordan: is this the scanner's service account losing a role? cc @Alex

Alex: yeah looks like the RBAC change removed a binding during the IAM cleanup. I saw a PR that removed wildcard grants earlier.

Sara: who applied that change? we need audit proof before changing perms back.

Oncall SRE: check admin audit log -> https://console.logs.company/internal?query=iam.setIamPolicy%20scanner-sa

Alex: found entry: user=infra-bot@redwood.com, change=removed role/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator

Olivia: is quick unblock ok? we can add binding temporarily and then make a scoped fix.

Jordan: :+1: for temporary unblock, but record on incident ticket and add alert to detect auth regressions.

Alex: command to re-grant:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding scanner-sa@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member=serviceAccount:infra-bot@redwood.com \
  --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
```

Olivia: I'll run that in staging now and re-run CI.

scan-bot: DAST RUN (re-run) 2025-06-12T15:07:03Z - test: web-login-smoke - status: PASS

Olivia: CI is green. Opening follow-up: add a preflight check in infra PRs that modify iam bindings for scanner-related accounts, and add an eval to catch auth-flaky in canaries.

Sara: also let's add an audit-alert rule: if role/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator removed from any scanner account -> page sec-oncall.

Oncall SRE: noted, I'll create the alert and ticket.

Jordan: thanks all. filing postmortem-lite in #incidents and linking the PR and audit log.

Alex: will send a small infra PR to require changelog entry for iam edits. :shipit:

Olivia: resolved — marking thread done. :white_check_mark:
